concurrency: Filesystem operations are serialized within the owning writer; the reader performs read-only verification.
purpose: Keep every written artifact inside the explicit run root, reject traversal, escaping symlinks and unsafe names on the resolved confined path, verify regular confined files, and detect a missing or mutated artifact by recorded size and content hash.
state: Owns the run-root confinement rule and the artifact index entries; owns no state outside the run root.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; confinement uses os.lstat/realpath and rejects symlinks on the resolved path
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned artifacts/reader sources plus a check that every path operation uses os.lstat/realpath confinement and rejects symlinks rather than caller-supplied text
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

static_checks.expected: ast analysis finds os.lstat, O_NOFOLLOW and an fstat identity comparison on the confined path before any JSON parse, and defensive copies for every returned artifact view
static_checks.rule: for the manifest, stream and every indexed artifact the read path resolves the confined real path and applies os.lstat plus an O_NOFOLLOW open with an fstat device/inode comparison before any parse; returned artifact/index views are independent copies
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)
